Extract inputs for create_NICHESObject from an AnnData (.h5ad) file

Source: R/extract_NICHESInputs_AnnData.R
extract_NICHESInputs_AnnData.Rd

Reads a .h5ad file using rhdf5 (no Python, no conda, no basilisk – pure C HDF5 bindings, compatible with R \(\geq\) 4.2) and returns the count matrix and cell metadata as a named list ready to pass directly to create_NICHESObject.

Usage

extract_NICHESInputs_AnnData(
  file,
  layer = "counts",
  obs.cols = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

file

Character. Full path to the .h5ad file, including the file name and extension (e.g. "/data/samples/sample1.h5ad").

layer

Character. Which data to extract. Default "counts" (raw UMI counts stored in adata.layers[["counts"]]), a starting point rather than a recommendation: this choice affects which edges score highest. Use "X" to extract adata.X directly. A hard error with available layer names is thrown if the layer is absent.

obs.cols

Character vector or NULL. Subset of adata.obs columns to keep. NULL (default) keeps all.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE (default), prints a summary and a spatial coordinate reminder.

Value

A named list:

count.mtx

Sparse dgCMatrix, genes \(\times\) cells. Row names are gene names; column names are cell barcodes.

meta.data

Data frame from adata.obs (optionally column-subsetted). Row names are cell barcodes.

Details

The AnnData layer structure maps to the layer argument as follows:

  • adata.X \(\rightarrow\) layer = "X"

  • adata.layers[["counts"]] \(\rightarrow\) layer = "counts"

  • any other named layer \(\rightarrow\) layer = "<name>"

Install rhdf5 with:


  BiocManager::install("rhdf5")

The function does not fetch spatial coordinates from adata.obsm. For spatial mode, add x and y columns to meta.data yourself:


  library(rhdf5)
  coords <- t(rhdf5::h5read(file, "obsm/spatial"))
  inputs$meta.data$x <- coords[, 1]
  inputs$meta.data$y <- coords[, 2]

See also

create_NICHESObject, extract_NICHESInputs_Seurat

Examples

if (requireNamespace("rhdf5", quietly = TRUE)) {
  h5ad.file <- system.file("extdata", "NICHESv2_example.h5ad",
                           package = "NICHESv2")
  inputs <- extract_NICHESInputs_AnnData(
    file    = h5ad.file,
    layer   = "counts",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  data(NICHESv2_inputs)
  niches.obj <- create_NICHESObject(
    count.mtx = inputs$count.mtx,
    meta.data = inputs$meta.data,
    LRM.db    = NICHESv2_inputs$LRM.db,
    mode      = "spatial",
    k         = 5L,
    verbose   = FALSE
  )
  niches.obj
}
